string.name: nadir

string.translation_description: Name of the notification channel for alerts shortly before a satellite passes overhead.

string.translation_description: Compact suffix appended after a widget rise/set time that falls on a later day than today, so a reader doesn\'t mistake it for today\'s crossing; %1$d is the number of days ahead (almost always 1). Keep it short — the widget is very narrow. Note the leading space.

string.translation_description: Title of the row on the Moon\'s info card offering to add the moon-phase widget to the home screen

string.translation_description: Subtitle of the row offering the moon-phase widget, summarizing what the widget shows

string.translation_description: Button that adds the moon-phase widget to the home screen via the system dialog

string.translation_description: Body of the fallback dialog explaining how to add the widget manually

resources.string: 런처에서 앱을 통해 위젯을 추가하는 것을 지원하지 않습니다. 홈 화면을 길게 터치하여 위젯을 선택한 다음, Sky Map을 찾으세요.
